description: Work on your PC, Mac, Linux server or VM with ChatGPT or other MCP-compatible AI assistants. Fix problems, manage files, run scripts and troubleshoot remotely.
name: relaydesk

capabilities: Fix a slow or malfunctioning PC
Work with files on your computer
interface.longDescription:
Turn your AI assistant into a hands-on helper for your own Windows PCs, Macs, Linux computers, servers and VMs. With RelayDesk, ChatGPT and other MCP-compatible AI assistants can diagnose problems, read and organize files, run approved commands and scripts, monitor tasks, and check real results on your paired machines—wherever you are.

Things you can ask your AI assistant to do on your computers:
• FIX MY PC — “My Windows PC is slow. Check running processes and disk usage, find the likely cause and help me fix it.”
• FIX A CRASHING APP — “This program keeps stopping on my laptop. Inspect its logs and process, explain the error and try a safe fix.”
• FREE UP DISK SPACE — “Find my largest folders and old downloads. Recommend what is safe to remove before deleting anything.”
• WORK WITH LOCAL FILES — “Find the report in my Documents folder, read it, summarize it and organize these project files.”
• OPERATE A BROWSER AUTOMATION SCRIPT — “Run my existing Playwright browser automation on my PC, investigate errors and help repair the script.”
• FIX MY SERVER — “My Linux app is down. Inspect its service, logs and configuration, diagnose the failure and help get it running.”
• BUILD & TEST CODE — “Run tests on my Mac or Windows project, investigate failures, fix the relevant code and rerun the tests.”
• RUN COMMANDS & SCRIPTS — “Run my approved local script, monitor the output and report what succeeded or failed.”
• CHECK ANY PAIRED MACHINE — “Which of my computers are online? What is running on my remote VM?”
• CONTINUE EXISTING WORK — “Check the output and progress of the task already running on my desktop without restarting it.”

RelayDesk connects through MCP-compatible AI clients, including ChatGPT. Use multiple explicitly paired devices from supported AI conversations, including remote computers at home or at work. Pair your machine with an OS-specific installer or a copyable terminal command. Features include local file search, reading and editing, directory organization, approved CLI and Git workflows, process diagnostics, connection checks and long-running process output.

Browser automation works through local scripts and tools already installed on the paired machine, such as Playwright; RelayDesk does not provide built-in visual browser clicking, desktop screen sharing or mouse control. Only explicitly paired and reachable devices can be accessed, within their local file and command safety restrictions. You approve consequential changes.
defaultPrompt: My Windows PC is running slowly. Check its processes and disk usage, find the likely causes, and suggest safe fixes.
Find the largest files in Downloads on my paired computer. Show safe cleanup options; do not delete anything yet.
On my paired PC, run my existing browser automation script and help fix any errors in the output.
